content: अनुराध {%a.%} .²1 Causing welfare; also written as अनूराध; इन्द्रं वयमनूराधं हवामहे <ls>Av.</ls> .²2 Born under the asterism अनुराधा <ls>P. IV. 3. 34</ls>. .{@-धः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a Buddhist. .{@-धा@} [अनुगता राधां विशाखाम्] <ab>N.</ab> of the 17th of the 27 lunar mansions or asterisms (so called because it follows राधा or विशाखा). It consists of four stars.
